comments.author: apfaffman
comments.body_html:
neat.

was looking into a way to bypass the launcher as i use gamescope and pass the exec command via a .desktop launcher

update:

well, figuring this out wasn’t straightforward. maybe i missed the part in the docs, but i had to change the exec command referencing SPT.Launcher.exe so it references EscapeFromTarkov.exe instead. this way, the launcher args generated by your tool are passed directly to the correct executable.

i don’t know how the Steam-purchased edition of the game launches it, so maybe this is inherent to my janky setup.

comments.author: ThunderArtist
comments.body_html: This launcher is for SPT 4.0.X and does not work with 4.1.X. Since 4.1.0 there is a Linux launcher included! That one WILL actually launch the game, I can’t wait to contribute to it :D I already have some quality of life things in mind. For now just remember to put WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command% as launch options or the game will crash instantly.
